concerns.text: FR-014 requires sampling from posterior distributions to create a point‑estimate dataset for the KS test, but pooling posterior draws across events destroys the i.i.d. assumption required by the Kolmogorov‑Smirnov test; the spec does not describe a valid procedure to obtain independent samples, so the KS validation is methodologically unsound.

The project deviates from Constitution Principle VI by using a synthetic power‑law catalog instead of the mandated IllustrisTNG/EAGLE simulation releases, yet the research question claims to test alignment with simulation predictions; this mismatch makes the core scientific claim unsupported.
